title: Account
summary: Mara's Account page at Profile, as built (PX-31a) on the 2026-10-20 shell: the display h1 with Sign out, the canonical sections (Profile, Sign-in methods, Connected apps, Packages, Where you're signed in, Appearance, Your data) as a side list and a pill strip on narrow screens, then one card per section: her picture, name and email; her sign-in methods in three groups; her two connected apps; her personal token; her two browsers; theme and motion; Download my data and Delete account.
compare: 2026-10-20 shell (PX-35, BR-lockups): no header Activate (it is the account menu's first item, portal.library-menu); no footer (Help and Privacy are in the account menu); the docked Library · Discover phone bar, neither tab current on Account; the trimmed Locker lockup; US dates ('Sep 19, 2026'). Redrawn to the built Account (AccountPage.tsx, components/account/*, PX-31a polish and PX-15): the build wins on every point below except where a line says 'Build follow-up'.

Title block: the h1 'Account' at the display step (48/52, 32/36 on a phone) and the outlined Sign out (log-out glyph, a form POST), nothing under the title: the email is Profile's (PX-31a, 'no h1 subline').

One section list, in this order (B12, portal-28): Profile · Sign-in methods · Connected apps · Packages · Where you're signed in · Appearance · Your data. The side list ('On this page') from 1280 px, current item on the neutral fill with the 3 px coral marker (D9a); below it a sticky pill strip ('Account sections') that scrolls sideways with a fade. A section with nothing to show leaves the list (Where you're signed in without the sessions API, Packages with no feed or token).

Section cards (kit .card.account-card, the build's AccountCard): the head carries the title and the section's one action at the right (Add, Sign out everywhere), wrapping under the title on a narrow card; a muted line under the head says what the section holds; rows lead with a 40 px tile, glyph in strong text; groups are labelled in 12 px sentence case ('Accounts', 'Email · sign in with a code', 'Passkeys'), never an uppercase eyebrow.

Profile: the 40 px picture with its source's badge (Google), the name, the email, and where each came from ('Name typed by you · picture from Google'); Edit (named 'Edit profile'); 'Add a picture' only when there is none. Editing happens in place (PX-22).

Sign-in methods: Add (a menu: Add an email, Add a passkey); Accounts (Google connected with its address and 'Connected Mar 4, 2026 · last used yesterday', Disconnect; Steam 'Not connected', Connect); Email (the primary tagged 'Primary', the other with 'Found 2 products', Make primary and Remove; 'Add an email' on the text column); Passkeys (Pixel 8, Remove; 'Add a passkey'). The footnote: 'Changing a method asks you to confirm it's you. Every change is recorded and emailed to <primary>.' then Link an existing account (PX-15). Removing confirms in the row (account-disconnect baseline), never a dialog.

Connected apps: the rows of identity.connected-apps (how the app signs in, when and on which device on one line, then what it gets as chips; Change what <App> gets and Disconnect). Build follow-up: the section is absent from the build until its API exists (PORTAL.md §7; I-34, PX-31b), between Sign-in methods and Packages.

Packages, as built (PackagesCard, F-33): 'A personal token is one read-only credential that installs every package your licenses include.', 'Your personal tokens' with Create personal token (the page's one filled action, ink), each token by its name and pkeyp_…4QXL with last use and expiry, Revoke confirmed in the row. The whole card (You can install, the setup) is drawn in packages.portal-packages. Build follow-up (minor): PackagesCard draws a 36 px Package glyph tile before the title; no other Account card has one, so the mockup leaves it out.

Where you're signed in: Sign out everywhere in the head; 'Browsers signed in to this account. Devices that use a license are on each product's page.'; this browser first with an outlined 'This browser' tag, the others with Sign out; 'Approve a new device' under the list.

Appearance: Theme (Match device, Dark, Light) and Motion (Match device, Reduced, with a line saying what the choice does) as compact segmented controls at the row's end; on a phone each control spans the card under its label.

Your data: Download my data ('Account, sign-in methods, licenses, devices and each app's data. No keys or tokens.') and Delete account ('Erased 14 days after you confirm. Licenses stay with each developer.', the danger-outline Delete account…). Risky actions stay in their own section; the page has one filled action (Create personal token).
Glyphs the kit lacks: Download my data's file-down is drawn with file-json, Approve a new device's scan-line with qr-code.
Phone: the pill strip under the header, one column of cards, row actions under the text, the docked bar at the bottom.
